subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agents.list[].agentDir` become a second authoritative bootstrap root that overrides the agent's configured workspace?
rationale: Current code and documentation assign bootstrap authority to the workspace and state/auth ownership to `agentDir`; changing that division can activate previously ignored instructions and therefore requires explicit security and compatibility intent.

options.title: Preserve workspace authority
options.body: Keep workspace bootstrap files canonical and use the warning or Doctor path to guide users who placed files in `agentDir`.

options.title: Approve dual-root authority
options.body: Define `agentDir` precedence as a supported contract and require documentation, upgrade diagnostics, threat-model review, regression coverage, and live CLI or Gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Pause this implementation
options.body: Close or defer this branch while the narrower warning implementation at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653 addresses the silent-misconfiguration problem.

recommendation.title: Preserve workspace authority
recommendation.body: Keep workspace bootstrap files canonical and use the warning or Doctor path to guide users who placed files in `agentDir`.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant merged history is the workspace-truth bootstrap routing refactor authored in commit 62703d84308ab526d968bf0d42c330685a9bfb90.
